chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from one of them, peace be upon them, concerning the saying of
Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “the life for the life, and the eye for the eye, and the nose for the nose”

key_terms.النَّفْسَ: the life or person subject to retaliation
key_terms.الْأَنْفَ: the nose, mentioned as part of bodily retaliation
key_terms.الْعَيْنَ: the eye, mentioned in the rule of equivalent retaliation
key_terms.مُحْكَمَةٌ: decisive, firm, and not abrogated in its ruling

ai.seo_question: Is the verse on retaliation in the Qur’an considered decisive and operative?
ai.summary: The hadith states that the verse concerning retaliation—life for life, eye for eye, and nose for nose—is muhkamah, meaning firm and decisive in ruling. It indicates the continued legal force and clarity of this Qur’anic judgment in the context of qisas.
